name: Evade
creator: Hexagon Development Community
redeem: Launch Evade on Roblox and stay in the lobby before you press Play.
Find the Twitter bird icon in the menu buttons along the edge of the screen and click it.
Paste a code into the Codes box, checking the capital letters and removing any spaces.
Press Enter to redeem, and the Points are added to your balance.
notes:
Evade is a movement game from Hexagon Development Community, inspired by Garry's Mod, where you run from Nextbots, the flat screaming faces that chase players across each map. Each round you sprint, slide, crouch, and bunny hop to stay alive, and you can revive teammates who get downed. Surviving and helping others earns Points, which you spend on emotes, cosmetics, and usable items.

Codes in Evade give Points, and once in a while a cosmetic. Points are the most useful reward because they unlock almost everything in the shop, from emotes to items like the boombox. New codes do not come often. They usually show up for the game's birthday, seasonal events, big updates, or as a thank you after server problems, and the developers post them on X and in their Discord.

faq.a: Yes, type them exactly as listed. For example isurviveddatahaul is all lowercase, while HAPPY4THBIRTHDAYEVADE is all capitals.

faq.q: Why can I not find the code button in Evade?
faq.a: Codes are redeemed through the Twitter bird icon in the lobby menu, not from inside a round. Leave the match or press M to open the menu if you are already playing.

faq.q: What should I spend Evade Points on?
faq.a: Many players buy emotes and usable items first, since they help you move or escape during rounds. Cosmetics are nice but do not change how you play.

tips: Stick to open areas where you have room to turn. Running into dead ends or narrow halls makes it easy for a Nextbot to catch you.
Revive downed teammates when it is safe, but do not run straight into a Nextbot to do it. Losing two players is worse than losing one.
Press 2 to open your usables menu quickly during a chase. Knowing where your items are saves precious seconds.
Use the whistle on T to help teammates find you. Grouping up makes it easier to revive each other.
useRewards: The four working codes give 180 Points in total, which is a small boost. Add them to the Points you earn from rounds and buy one useful item before spending on cosmetics. The long Trollge code is easy to mistype, so copy and paste it. Codes are rare here, so redeem new ones quickly when they show up for events or the game's birthday.
